g.text: narrow data plane behind harness tools
Q1 auth, scope, generation state, progress stream
The fixed paper scope is a Java product decision.
Python can narrow within it, not expand beyond it.
Reading memory carries previous accepted evidence and clicked anchors.
paper candidate -> location candidate -> exact read -> Evidence ID -> accepted answer.
Only read_locations creates citeable paper-content evidence.
Exact text is reopened from MySQL, not from Qdrant.
resolve/lock source scope + assert focus within scope

papers, Reading Model, conversations, source quote tables

resolve clicked reference number when needed

compact history + latest reference mappings + reading state
reserve before dispatch; settle/abort after terminal result
